worldImage.composition: Source zoom-3 tiles, exactly 8 by 8; 200 px each; row y, column x. Original tiles retained.

facts: Source page mapDatas declares initLocation [[0,0],[-180,180]], tileSize [180,180], tile mode.
Map script creates CRS.Simple map and Leaflet tile layer. Image tile actual resolution 200px is displayed in 180x180 coordinate units at z0.
Normalized coordinates correspond to this GameWith background only, not the Game8 world image.

limitations: Some DQ1 source articleUrl values mistakenly use /wutheringwaves/; preserved verbatim. Use sourcePage or verify destination with location catalog.
Source pinImage often lists two image URLs separated by comma.
Raw HTML descriptions and original Japanese names retained.
Do not directly overlay GameWith coordinates onto the Game8 image; independent map crop and layout.
